```{r}
library('hypervolume')
library('alphahull')
library('BSDA')
library('data.table')
library('cocor')
library('rmcorr')
library('MVN')
require("cocor")
```

```{r}
PanTHERIAFrame <- data.frame(read.table(file = 'Data/PanTHERIA_1-0_WR93_Aug2008.txt', header = TRUE, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = TRUE))
AmnioteFrame <- data.frame(read.table(file = 'Data/Amniote.txt', header = TRUE, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = TRUE)) 
CombineFrame <- data.frame(read.csv(file = 'Data/COMBINE.csv', header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = TRUE)) 
ErnestFrame <- data.frame(read.table(file = 'Data/Ernest.txt', header = TRUE, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = TRUE)) 
PhylacineFrame <- data.frame(read.csv(file = 'Data/phylacine.csv', header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = TRUE)) 

# Combine has some duplicate rows
CombineFrame <- CombineFrame |>
  dplyr::distinct(binomial, .keep_all = TRUE)


# Same species as PANtheria
PanTHERIAFrame_b <- data.frame(MSW93_Binomial = species_names[, 1]) |>
  dplyr::left_join(PanTHERIAFrame, by = names(PanTHERIAFrame)[1])

AmnioteFrame_b <- data.frame(binomial = species_names[, 1]) |>
  dplyr::left_join(AmnioteFrame, by = names(AmnioteFrame)[1])

CombineFrame_b <- data.frame(binomial = species_names[, 1]) |>
  dplyr::left_join(CombineFrame, by = names(CombineFrame)[1])

ErnestFrame_b <- data.frame(binomial = species_names[, 1]) |>
  dplyr::left_join(ErnestFrame, by = names(ErnestFrame)[1])

PhylacineFrame_b <- data.frame(Binomial = species_names[, 1]) |>
  dplyr::left_join(PhylacineFrame, by = names(PhylacineFrame)[1])


# Check alignment - All TRUE
identical(
  as.character(PanTHERIAFrame_b[, 1]), 
  as.character(AmnioteFrame_b[, 1])
)
identical(
  as.character(PanTHERIAFrame_b[, 1]), 
  as.character(CombineFrame_b[, 1])
)
identical(
  as.character(PanTHERIAFrame_b[, 1]), 
  as.character(ErnestFrame_b[, 1])
)
identical(
  as.character(PanTHERIAFrame_b[, 1]), 
  as.character(PhylacineFrame_b[, 1])
)


# Fix units
# Pantheria and Ernest - longevity months  into days
PanTHERIAFrame_b[, 5] <- PanTHERIAFrame_b[, 5] * 30.44
ErnestFrame_b[, 5] <- ErnestFrame_b[, 5] * 30.44
# Amniote - longevity years  into days
AmnioteFrame_b[, 5] <- AmnioteFrame_b[, 5] * 365

# Remove the species names column
PanTHERIAFrame_b <- PanTHERIAFrame_b[, c(2:7)]
AmnioteFrame_b <- AmnioteFrame_b[, c(2:7)]
CombineFrame_b <- CombineFrame_b[, c(2:7)]
ErnestFrame_b <- ErnestFrame_b[, c(2:7)]
PhylacineFrame_b <- PhylacineFrame_b[, c(2:7)]



# Put all datasets into a list
Frames <- list(PanTHERIAFrame_b, AmnioteFrame_b, CombineFrame_b, ErnestFrame_b, PhylacineFrame_b)  # add all your datasets here

# Combine them into an array
data_array <- array(
  unlist(Frames),
  dim = c(nrow(Frames[[1]]), ncol(Frames[[1]]), length(Frames))
)

# Calculate the mean for each cell across all datasets
Frameconc <- apply(data_array, c(1, 2), mean, na.rm = TRUE)

write.table(Frameconc_temp_2, file = 'Full_Mammals_empirical.txt', col.names = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, sep = "\t")
```
